cards.name: IVGTextColumns
cards.summary: Collection of the text columns that a text range spans in a multi-column paragraph text frame, from TextRange.Columns. Each item comes back as an IVGTextRange holding the text of that column, so a script can read or format copy column by column.
use_for: giving the first column of a two-column brochure panel a larger lead-in size
checking how much copy landed in each column of a newsletter frame before changing the column count
reading the text of the last column to spot a nearly empty column
avoid: changing how many columns a frame has or their widths: use IVGTextFrame.SetColumns
artistic text or single-column frames: there is only one column, use Paragraphs or Lines instead
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface, a read-only collection returned by IVGTextRange.Columns, e.g. ActiveShape.Text.Story.Columns. Items are IVGTextRange objects (not frame objects), so every character and paragraph member of TextRange works on them. Walk it with Count + Item (base 1) or For Each.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of columns the range spans

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: TextRange of column Index (base 1); the optional Count (default 1) joins that many consecutive columns into one range

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: TextRange of the first column

key_members.name: Last
key_members.use: TextRange of the last column

key_members.name: All
key_members.use: one TextRange covering all the columns in the collection

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the columns

gotchas: The type library describes Item as 'the specified word': a copy-paste slip. It returns the text of a column as a TextRange.
Columns follow the current layout: a change of frame size, font size or column setup moves the column boundaries, so read Columns again after any layout change.
The collection covers the columns the RANGE touches, not every column of the frame (unverified for a range that covers only part of the text).
A column with no text flowed into it may not be counted (unverified).
cards.example:
Set cols = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Columns
Debug.Print cols.Count
If cols.Count > 1 Then cols.First.Size = 14
For Each c In cols
  Debug.Print c.Length
Next

cards.name: IVGTextFrame
cards.summary: One frame of a paragraph text story: the box, shape container or path that holds part of the text. It gives the text currently in that frame, its place in a linked chain (Previous / Next / IsFirst / IsLast), its columns and vertical alignment, its background fill, and lets a script link it to another shape so overflow text flows on.
use_for: threading overflow copy from a magazine page frame into a frame on the next page
setting a two- or three-column layout on a flyer's body-copy frame
vertically centring copy inside a fixed-size badge, button or callout box
finding empty frames at the end of a linked chain in a template so the script can remove them
giving a text box a background tint behind the copy
avoid: artistic text: it has no columns or links; convert it with Text.ConvertToParagraph (an IVGText member) first
character or paragraph formatting: use the TextRange returned by Range
shrinking text to fit: use Text.FitTextToFrame on IVGText
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface for one frame of a paragraph text story. Get it from a text shape with ActiveShape.Text.Frame (that shape's own frame) or ActiveShape.Text.Frames.Item(i) (every frame of the linked story), or from TextRange.Frames. Frame-level layout lives here (columns, vertical alignment, linking, background fill); the characters are reached through Range.

key_members.name: Range
key_members.use: TextRange of just the text that currently sits in this frame

key_members.name: Next
key_members.use: the next frame in the linked chain (if any)

key_members.name: Previous
key_members.use: the previous frame in the linked chain (if any)

key_members.name: IsFirst
key_members.use: True for the first frame of the chain

key_members.name: IsLast
key_members.use: True for the last frame of the chain

key_members.name: Empty
key_members.use: True when no text flows into this frame

key_members.name: Index
key_members.use: position of the frame in the chain

key_members.name: VerticalAlignment
key_members.use: cdrTopJustify / cdrCenterJustify / cdrBottomJustify / cdrFullJustify

key_members.name: SetColumns
key_members.use: set NumColumns, EqualColumns and a Variant array of widths and gutters

key_members.name: ColumnCount
key_members.use: number of columns in the frame

key_members.name: ColumnWidth
key_members.use: width of column Index

key_members.name: ColumnGutter
key_members.use: gutter (space between columns) at column Index

key_members.name: LinkTo
key_members.use: flow this frame's overflow into another shape

key_members.name: UnLink
key_members.use: break the link so the frame stops passing text on

key_members.name: Container
key_members.use: the shape the frame sits inside when the text is placed in an object

key_members.name: IsInsideContainer
key_members.use: True when the paragraph text is inside a container shape

key_members.name: IsFittedToPath
key_members.use: True when the text is fitted to a path

key_members.name: Path
key_members.use: the path shape the text is fitted to

key_members.name: FrameShape
key_members.use: the text shape that hosts this frame

key_members.name: Fill
key_members.use: background fill of the frame (not the text colour)

gotchas: SetColumns widths and gutters, ColumnWidth and ColumnGutter are in document units (ActiveDocument.Unit) (unverified for this class).

WidthsAndGutters is a flat Variant array; with EqualColumns = True only one width / gutter pair should matter, with False it alternates width, gutter per column (array layout unverified). Pass Array(...) of numbers even for equal columns.
ColumnWidth / ColumnGutter take an Index whose base (0 or 1) the type library does not state (unverified, try 1).
LinkTo needs a target that can hold text, such as an empty paragraph text frame or a closed curve; artistic text or an open path behaves differently (unverified).
Fill is the frame background; the colour of the letters is TextRange.Fill.
Text that fits in no frame is overflow and belongs to no frame's Range; check IVGText.Overflow.
cards.example:
Set f = ActiveShape.Text.Frame
f.SetColumns 2, True, Array(1.8, 0.25)   ' width, gutter (unverified)
f.VerticalAlignment = cdrCenterJustify
Debug.Print f.ColumnCount, f.Range.Length
If Not f.IsLast Then Debug.Print f.Next.Empty
Set nextBox = ActivePage.Shapes.Item("NextFrame")   ' an empty paragraph text shape
f.LinkTo nextBox

review.changes: ColumnGutter use said 'space after column Index' (typelib: space between columns); removed invented 'inches unless set' document-unit default; example used an undefined nextBox; now set from ActivePage.Shapes.Item(name)

cards.name: IVGTextFrames
cards.summary: Collection of the frames a paragraph text story flows through (its linked frame chain), from IVGText.Frames or TextRange.Frames. Gives each IVGTextFrame in link order, the frame count, and TextRanges covering one or several frames.
use_for: walking every frame of a story threaded across pages to give them all the same column layout
finding the last frame of a chain to link a new overflow frame onto it
formatting all text in frames 2-3 of a multi-page leaflet in one call
avoid: reading the whole text in story order: Text.Story is simpler than joining frames
artistic text: it has a single frame and no chain
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface, a read-only collection. ActiveShape.Text.Frames lists the frames of the linked story the shape belongs to; TextRange.Frames lists only the frames that range touches. Item, First and Last return IVGTextFrame objects; Range and All return text as IVGTextRange.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of frames

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: one IVGTextFrame by index, base 1

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: the first frame (IVGTextFrame)

key_members.name: Last
key_members.use: the last frame (IVGTextFrame)

key_members.name: Range
key_members.use: TextRange of Count frames (default 1) starting at frame Index

key_members.name: All
key_members.use: TextRange of the text in all frames of the collection

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the frames

gotchas: Item / First / Last give frame objects, but Range / All give text: Range(2) is the text of frame 2, Item(2) is the frame itself.
Frames are in link order, not page or stacking order (unverified).
After LinkTo / UnLink on a frame, read Frames again; the old collection may describe the old chain (unverified).
cards.example:
Set fr = ActiveShape.Text.Frames
For i = 1 To fr.Count
  fr.Item(i).VerticalAlignment = cdrTopJustify
Next
If fr.Count > 1 Then Debug.Print fr.Range(1, 2).Length
Debug.Print fr.Last.Empty

review.changes: marked link-order claim unverified; example guarded Range(1, 2) so a one-frame story does not fail

cards.name: IVGTextIndentLevelStyle
cards.summary: Bullet or numbering settings for one indent level of a list in paragraph text: the numbering scheme (bullet, Roman, Latin letters, Hindi, Arabic and other scripts), bullet symbol and font, a format string for prefixes / suffixes, glyph size and baseline shift, and the width of the bullet area. Whether a change applies only to the paragraphs of the range it came from or to the whole story is not stated in the type library.
use_for: building an outline-numbered agenda or step list in a brochure (I. / A. / 1. per level)
setting a custom level-1 bullet glyph and size for feature points on a flyer
matching sub-list styling (smaller dash bullets) across several text frames of a catalogue
avoid: simple single-level bullets: TextRange.ApplyBulletEffect is shorter
drop caps: use TextRange.ApplyDropCapEffect
choosing which level a paragraph is on: that is TextRange.IndentLevel
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface for the list formatting of one indent level. Reach it with rng.IndentLevelStyles.Item(n), where rng is a paragraph-text IVGTextRange (e.g. ActiveShape.Text.Story); the level a paragraph uses is set with rng.IndentLevel. Every property except Level is read/write.

key_members.name: Level
key_members.use: the indent level this style belongs to (read-only)

key_members.name: NumberStyle
key_members.use: numbering scheme, a cdrTextIndentLevelStyle value (cdrTextIndentLevelStyleBullet, ...UppercaseRomanNumeral, ...LowercaseLatin ...)

key_members.name: Symbol
key_members.use: the character used as the bullet

key_members.name: Font
key_members.use: font face of the bullet or number

key_members.name: UseParagraphFont
key_members.use: use the paragraph's own font for the number instead of Font

key_members.name: Size
key_members.use: size of the bullet or number in points

key_members.name: BaselineShift
key_members.use: vertical shift of the bullet or number from the baseline, in points

key_members.name: Format
key_members.use: number format string with a placeholder for the bullet / number, e.g. to add a prefix or suffix

key_members.name: FirstCharIndent
key_members.use: width of the bullet / number area

key_members.name: FirstCharIndentIncludesBullet
key_members.use: whether FirstCharIndent includes the bullet width

key_members.name: HangingIndent
key_members.use: hang the paragraph's following lines past the bullet

gotchas: The placeholder token inside Format is not documented in the type library (unverified): read the existing Format first and keep its token when adding a prefix or suffix.
NumberStyle cdrTextIndentLevelStyleBullet (0) uses Symbol; the numbering values generate numbers or letters and should ignore Symbol (unverified).
FirstCharIndent is a double, presumably in document units (unverified); Size and BaselineShift are points per the type library.
Nothing shows until the paragraphs carry a bullet / list effect (TextRange.Effect); setting a level style alone may change nothing visible (unverified).
Paragraph text only; artistic text has no list levels (unverified).
cards.example:
Set rng = ActiveShape.Text.Story
rng.ApplyBulletEffect
Set lv = rng.IndentLevelStyles.Item(1)
lv.NumberStyle = cdrTextIndentLevelStyleUppercaseRomanNumeral
lv.Size = 10
Debug.Print lv.Level, lv.Format

cards.name: IVGTextIndentLevelStyles
cards.summary: The set of per-level list styles (bullet or numbering settings for each possible indent level) of a text range, from TextRange.IndentLevelStyles; each item is an IVGTextIndentLevelStyle.
use_for: setting a full outline numbering scheme (I. / A. / 1.) for a multi-level agenda in one loop
reading the list setup of a template text frame to copy it onto another frame
avoid: putting a paragraph on a level: set TextRange.IndentLevel
single-level bullets: TextRange.ApplyBulletEffect
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface, a read-only collection returned by IVGTextRange.IndentLevelStyles (e.g. ActiveShape.Text.Story.IndentLevelStyles). Count is the number of indent levels available; Item(Index) returns that level's IVGTextIndentLevelStyle.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of indent level styles available

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: the IVGTextIndentLevelStyle for one level

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the levels

gotchas: The base of Item's Index is not stated (unverified): compare Item(i).Level with i before relying on base 1.
Count is the number of POSSIBLE levels ('all possible indent level properties'), not the number of levels the text actually uses.
Paragraph text only (unverified for artistic text).
cards.example:
Set lvls = ActiveShape.Text.Story.IndentLevelStyles
Debug.Print lvls.Count
For Each lv In lvls
  Debug.Print lv.Level, lv.NumberStyle, lv.Symbol
Next
lvls.Item(2).NumberStyle = cdrTextIndentLevelStyleLowercaseLatin

cards.name: IVGTextLines
cards.summary: Collection of the laid-out lines of a text range, from TextRange.Lines; each item is an IVGTextRange covering one line as the text currently wraps. Lets a script read or format text by visual line (first line, last line, number of lines).
use_for: making the first line of an article intro bold or larger as a typographic lead-in
counting lines to check that copy fits a fixed number of lines on a label, tag or banner
finding a last line with a single short word (a widow) to adjust tracking
avoid: paragraph formatting: use Paragraphs (a line is not a paragraph)
remembering places in the text: lines move on every reflow, store Start / End positions instead
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface, a read-only collection returned by IVGTextRange.Lines, e.g. ActiveShape.Text.Story.Lines. Item(Index, Count) returns a TextRange of Count lines (default 1) starting at line Index (base 1 like Words / Columns; the type library does not state it for Lines, unverified); First, Last and All are TextRanges too.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of lines in the range

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: TextRange of Count lines (default 1) from line Index (base 1 assumed, unverified)

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: TextRange of the first line

key_members.name: Last
key_members.use: TextRange of the last line

key_members.name: All
key_members.use: TextRange of all lines in the collection

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the lines

gotchas: Lines follow the current wrap: changing the font, size, frame width or columns moves line ends, so read Lines again after every formatting change.
Enlarging line 1 can push its last words onto line 2; the range you styled does not grow or shrink to follow the new line end (unverified).
In paragraph text a line is each laid-out line, whether it ends at a wrap or a hard return; artistic text only breaks at hard returns.
Text in overflow (outside every frame) may not be counted as lines (unverified).
cards.example:
Set ln = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Lines
Debug.Print ln.Count
ln.First.Bold = True
ln.First.Size = 14
If ln.Count >= 3 Then Debug.Print ln.Item(2, 2).Text

review.changes: Item base 1 is not in the typelib for Lines: marked assumed/unverified; paragraph-text line definition said 'soft-wrapped' only; hard-return lines count too; marked reflow claim unverified; example guarded Item(2, 2) for short text

cards.name: IVGTextParagraphs
cards.summary: Collection of the paragraphs (blocks ended by a hard return) in a text range, from TextRange.Paragraphs; each item is an IVGTextRange covering one or several whole paragraphs.
use_for: styling the headline paragraph of a text frame differently from the body copy
adding space after every body paragraph except the first in an article frame
putting bullets on paragraphs 2-5 of a feature list on a product sheet
avoid: visual lines: use Lines
one named paragraph style everywhere: TextRange.ApplyStyle on the whole story is shorter
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface, a read-only collection returned by IVGTextRange.Paragraphs (e.g. ActiveShape.Text.Story.Paragraphs). Item(Index, Count) gives a TextRange of Count paragraphs (default 1) from paragraph Index (base 1 like Words / Columns; not stated for Paragraphs, unverified); First, Last and All are TextRanges too.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of paragraphs in the range

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: TextRange of Count paragraphs (default 1) from paragraph Index (base 1 assumed, unverified)

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: TextRange of the first paragraph

key_members.name: Last
key_members.use: TextRange of the last paragraph

key_members.name: All
key_members.use: TextRange of all paragraphs in the collection

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the paragraphs

gotchas: A paragraph range probably includes its paragraph mark (unverified), so Replace on Item(i) can merge it with the next paragraph; replace a sub-range or add vbCr back.
Count and positions change when you insert or delete paragraph breaks: loop from Count down to 1 when editing text.
Paragraph-level properties (Alignment, indents, spacing) set on a range apply to the whole paragraphs it touches anyway (unverified); Paragraphs is for choosing WHICH paragraphs.
cards.example:
Set ps = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Paragraphs
ps.First.Size = 24
ps.First.Bold = True
If ps.Count > 2 Then ps.Item(2, ps.Count - 2).ApplyBulletEffect
ps.Last.Alignment = cdrRightAlignment

review.changes: Item base 1 is not in the typelib for Paragraphs: marked assumed/unverified; marked whole-paragraph claim unverified

cards.name: IVGTextRange
cards.summary: A run of characters inside a CorelDRAW text object (artistic or paragraph text) and the main scripting handle for text: read, insert, replace and delete characters; set character formatting (font, size, bold / italic, case, spacing, kerning, OpenType features, fill and outline) and paragraph formatting (alignment, indents, line and paragraph spacing, hyphenation, tabs, bullets, drop caps, indent levels, object styles). Sub-collections split it into characters, words, lines, paragraphs, columns and frames.
use_for: filling names, prices or dates into a template text frame and styling only the inserted part
setting font, size, tracking and line spacing for headline versus body copy in a poster or brochure build
adding bullets or a drop cap to newsletter body copy
find-and-style: recolouring every price or keyword in a menu with FindRanges / EnumRanges
switching on OpenType ligatures or small caps for a wordmark or wedding invitation
avoid: frame layout (columns, linking, vertical alignment): use IVGTextFrame
converting text to curves or between artistic and paragraph text: those are shape / IVGText members
looping over Characters one by one on long text: one FindRanges or EnumRanges call does it in a single pass
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface. Get one from a text shape: ActiveShape.Text.Story (all the text), ActiveShape.Text.Selection (characters selected while editing), ActiveShape.Text.Range(Start, End), or ActiveShape.Text.Frame.Range (text in one frame). Narrow it with Range(Start, End), Characters / Words / Lines / Paragraphs .Item(...), FindRanges or EnumRanges. Every write goes straight to the document; wrap a batch of edits in ActiveDocument.BeginCommandGroup / EndCommandGroup for one undo step.

key_members.name: Text
key_members.use: read or replace the whole string of the range

key_members.name: Range
key_members.use: sub-range by Start / End offsets relative to this range

key_members.name: Characters
key_members.use: collection of single characters

key_members.name: Words
key_members.use: collection of words

key_members.name: Paragraphs
key_members.use: collection of paragraphs

key_members.name: InsertAfter
key_members.use: insert text after the range; returns a range of only the inserted characters

key_members.name: Replace
key_members.use: replace the range with new text; returns the new range

key_members.name: Delete
key_members.use: delete the characters

key_members.name: Font
key_members.use: font family name

key_members.name: Size
key_members.use: font size in points

key_members.name: Bold
key_members.use: bold on / off

key_members.name: Fill
key_members.use: fill of the characters (text colour); modify the returned object

key_members.name: Alignment
key_members.use: paragraph alignment, cdrAlignment (left, right, center, full / force justify)

key_members.name: LineSpacing
key_members.use: line spacing in the current LineSpacingType unit

key_members.name: SetLineSpacing
key_members.use: set the line spacing type and value plus space before / after in one call

key_members.name: CharSpacing
key_members.use: character spacing (tracking)

key_members.name: FindRanges
key_members.use: all character ranges matching a CQL query, as IVGTextRanges

key_members.name: EnumRanges
key_members.use: split the range into runs sharing attributes (cdrTextPropertySet filter)

key_members.name: ApplyStyle
key_members.use: apply a named object style to the text

key_members.name: SetOpenTypeFeature
key_members.use: set the state of an OpenType feature named by a string (a four-letter tag such as liga is assumed, unverified)

gotchas: The type library does not state the base of Start, End, Range(Start, End) and SetRange offsets (0-based assumed, unverified; IVGText.Replace's StartIndex defaults to 1). Words / Columns / Frames .Item are documented as base 1, Characters / Lines / Paragraphs .Item presumably too. Range(Start, End) is relative to THIS range, not the story.
Replace / Insert* / Delete shift every position after the edit: when editing several FindRanges hits, walk them through IVGTextRanges.Reverse.

LineSpacingType is read-only: change the spacing unit with SetLineSpacing(Type, LineSpacing, ParaBefore, ParaAfter); the optional values default to -1, presumably 'leave unchanged' (meaning of -1 unverified).
Paragraph properties (Alignment, indents, spacing, hyphenation, Tabs, bullets, drop cap, IndentLevel) apply to every paragraph the range touches, even partly (unverified).

Indents, HyphenHotZone, DropCapDistanceFromText and BulletHorizontalPosition are presumably in document units (ActiveDocument.Unit, unverified); BulletSize is in points per the type library, Size is the font size in points.

A property read over mixed text returns a 'mixed' value (cdrMixedAlignment, cdrMixedFontLine, cdrMixedLineSpacing, cdrTextEffectMixed); numeric properties may return a meaningless number (unverified). Use EnumRanges to read each run.
Fill and Outline are read-only properties, but the objects they return are live: change the colour through them instead of assigning a new object.
Collapse with no argument collapses to the END of the range (ToEnd defaults to True).
Select puts the shape into text editing (unverified), and Copy / Paste use the Windows clipboard: avoid them in unattended scripts.
FindRanges / Evaluate take CQL (Corel Query Language) expressions; the text property names to use in the query are not listed in the type library (unverified, test on a copy).
cards.example:
Set st = ActiveShape.Text.Story
st.Font = "Arial"
st.Size = 12
Set r = st.InsertAfter(" Rs 499")
r.Bold = True
st.Paragraphs.First.Alignment = cdrCenterAlignment
st.SetLineSpacing cdrPercentOfCharacterHeightLineSpacing, 120
st.SetOpenTypeFeature "liga", 1   ' tag format and 1 = on unverified

review.changes: 0-based offset claim and Item base 1 for Characters/Lines/Paragraphs are not in the typelib: marked unverified; -1 'unchanged' meaning, whole-paragraph and Select claims marked unverified; removed invented 'inches unless set' document-unit default; OpenType feature-tag format marked unverified

cards.name: IVGTextRanges
cards.summary: A list of separate text ranges returned by TextRange.FindRanges (ranges matching a CQL query) and TextRange.EnumRanges (runs of characters sharing the same attributes). Each item is an IVGTextRange; Reverse gives the list back to front.
use_for: recolouring every price or keyword found in a menu or price list
listing the font and size runs in a client's copy to audit it against a brand typography spec
replacing every run of a stray font in imported copy with the house font
avoid: fixed structural units (words, lines, paragraphs): use those collections on IVGTextRange
plain string search-and-replace: IVGText.Replace is simpler
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface, a read-only collection. Get it from IVGTextRange.FindRanges(Query) or IVGTextRange.EnumRanges(PropertyFilter) on e.g. ActiveShape.Text.Story; walk it with Count + Item or For Each, and go through Reverse before edits that change the text length.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of ranges found

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: one IVGTextRange by index

key_members.name: First
key_members.use: the first range

key_members.name: Last
key_members.use: the last range

key_members.name: Reverse
key_members.use: a new collection with the ranges in reverse order

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the ranges

gotchas: Each range holds character positions: Replace / Delete / Insert on an early item shifts the later ones, so edit text through rs.Reverse (formatting-only changes are safe in any order).
Reverse returns a NEW collection; the original keeps its order.

EnumRanges' PropertyFilter is a cdrTextPropertySet bit mask (Fill 1, Outline 2, Font 4, Size 8, Style 16; -1 = all, the default): the values are powers of two, so adding them should split runs only on the attributes you care about (combining unverified).
The base of Item's index is not stated for this collection (unverified, assume 1 like the other text collections).
cards.example:
Set rs = ActiveShape.Text.Story.EnumRanges(cdrTextPropertyFont)
For Each r In rs
  Debug.Print r.Font, r.Length
Next
Set rv = rs.Reverse
Debug.Print rs.Count, rv.First.Text

review.changes: bit-mask combining of cdrTextPropertySet values marked unverified (typelib lists single values only)

cards.name: IVGTextTabPosition
cards.summary: One tab stop of a paragraph: its horizontal position, alignment (left, right, centre or decimal), whether the gap before it is filled with leader characters, and Delete to remove it. Items of TextRange.Tabs.
use_for: lining up prices on a decimal tab in a restaurant menu
a dot-leader tab for a table of contents or price list
a right-aligned tab for the date column of a letterhead or invoice template
avoid: real tables with borders or cell fills: use a CorelDRAW table object
the leader character or spacing: those are set for all stops on IVGTextTabPositions
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface for one tab stop. Get it from rng.Tabs.Item(i) or as the return value of rng.Tabs.Add(...), where rng is an IVGTextRange such as ActiveShape.Text.Story.

key_members.name: Position
key_members.use: horizontal position of the stop in the text frame

key_members.name: Alignment
key_members.use: cdrTextTabLeft / cdrTextTabRight / cdrTextTabCenter / cdrTextTabDecimal

key_members.name: Leadered
key_members.use: fill the space before the stop with the leader character

key_members.name: Index
key_members.use: index of the stop among all stops (read-only)

key_members.name: Delete
key_members.use: remove this tab stop

gotchas: Position is in document units (ActiveDocument.Unit), measured in the text frame (unverified whether from the frame edge or the left indent).
The leader character and spacing are not per stop: set LeaderCharacter / LeaderSpacing on the parent Tabs collection.
Tabs belong to paragraphs: a stop read through a range covering paragraphs with different tabs may show only the first paragraph's stops (unverified).
Changing Position may re-sort the stops, so Index can change (unverified).
cards.example:
Set t = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Tabs.Add(4.5, cdrTextTabDecimal, True)
Debug.Print t.Index, t.Position
t.Alignment = cdrTextTabRight
t.Leadered = False
t.Delete

cards.name: IVGTextTabPositions
cards.summary: All tab stops of the paragraphs in a text range (TextRange.Tabs): add one stop, add stops at a regular interval, clear them, and set the leader character and spacing used by leadered stops.
use_for: setting up a menu or price-list layout with a dot-leader right tab in a few lines
clearing inherited tab stops from imported Word copy before applying the house template
laying out a timetable or spec sheet with evenly spaced tab columns via AddEvery
avoid: real tables: use a table object
changing one stop's alignment or position: use that IVGTextTabPosition
cards.how: VGCore dual dispinterface, a collection returned by IVGTextRange.Tabs (e.g. ActiveShape.Text.Story.Tabs). Count / Item give IVGTextTabPosition objects; Add, AddEvery and Clear edit the stops of every paragraph in the range; LeaderCharacter and LeaderSpacing apply to all leadered stops in the range.

key_members.name: Count
key_members.use: number of tab stops defined for the range

key_members.name: Item
key_members.use: one IVGTextTabPosition by index

key_members.name: _NewEnum
key_members.use: lets For Each walk the stops

key_members.name: Add
key_members.use: add a stop at Position with Alignment and Leadered; returns the new IVGTextTabPosition

key_members.name: AddEvery
key_members.use: add stops every Position units across the frame

key_members.name: Clear
key_members.use: delete all tab stops in the range

key_members.name: LeaderCharacter
key_members.use: character(s) used to fill leadered tabs, e.g. "."

key_members.name: LeaderSpacing
key_members.use: spacing between leader characters for all stops in the range

gotchas: Add / AddEvery default Alignment to 0 (cdrTextTabLeft) and Leadered to False: pass both for right or decimal leader tabs.
Positions are in document units (ActiveDocument.Unit) (unverified for this class).
Tabs are per paragraph: a range covering part of a paragraph edits the tabs of that whole paragraph (unverified).
LeaderSpacing is a Long whose unit is not documented (unverified).
Item index base is not stated (unverified, assume 1).
cards.example:
Set tb = ActiveShape.Text.Story.Tabs
tb.Clear
tb.Add 3.5, cdrTextTabRight, True
tb.LeaderCharacter = "."
tb.LeaderSpacing = 2
Debug.Print tb.Count, tb.Item(1).Position

review.changes: removed invented 'inches unless set' document-unit default; removed invented 'try 1-5' LeaderSpacing range; marked whole-paragraph claim unverified
